---
title: "Metrics"
subtitle: "Tracked, and stays valued — measured from telemetry."
---

Two headline metrics, both read straight from Whetstone's `events.jsonl` telemetry and the recorded
runs — never hand-set:

- **Runs-to-stick** — how many warm (post-correction) runs pass before a preference is applied
  without needing to be re-corrected. Lower is faster learning.
- **Value-over-time** — a learning's `weight` / `recurrence` trajectory across later runs: does the
  correction *keep* being valued, or decay away?

```{python}
# | echo: false
# | output: asis
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from _charts import charts_html  # noqa: E402
from _showcase import load_metrics, not_generated_note  # noqa: E402
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display  # noqa: E402

m = load_metrics()
if m is None:
    display(not_generated_note("The runs-to-stick chart and value-over-time trajectories"))
else:
    # All skills. `aggregate` already spans every scenario in metrics.json; the charts and detail
    # table read `scenarios` directly, so the numbers here cover great-tables, frontend-design, and
    # pptx together — the same set the Before / After page shows.
    a = m["aggregate"]
    display(Markdown(
        "### Aggregate <small>(all skills)</small>\n\n"
        "| metric | value |\n| --- | --- |\n"
        f"| scenarios | {a['scenarios']} |\n"
        f"| preferences (total) | {a['preferences_total']} |\n"
        f"| wrong in the cold run | {a['preferences_wrong_in_cold']} |\n"
        f"| stuck after correction | {a['preferences_stuck']} ({a['stuck_rate']}) |\n"
        f"| median runs-to-stick | {a['median_runs_to_stick']} |\n"
    ))
    # Per-skill breakdown — each slice has the same shape as `aggregate`, so the same substrate is
    # shown holding across three different skill classes, not just one.
    skills = m.get("skills", {})
    if len(skills) > 1:
        rows = ["\n### Per skill\n",
                "| skill | scenarios | stuck after correction | median runs-to-stick |",
                "| --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
        for name, s in sorted(skills.items()):
            rows.append(f"| {name} | {s['scenarios']} | "
                        f"{s['preferences_stuck']}/{s['preferences_total']} ({s['stuck_rate']}) | "
                        f"{s['median_runs_to_stick']} |")
        display(Markdown("\n".join(rows)))
    # The charts (static SVG, light + dark surfaces from the validated dataviz palette).
    display(HTML(charts_html(m)))
    # Companion table view (the relief the light-surface contrast WARN requires): final weight +
    # runs-to-stick per preference, in the same order as the charts.
    rows = ["\n### Per-preference detail\n", "| skill | scenario | preference | polarity |"
            " runs-to-stick | final weight |", "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
    for scn, s in m["scenarios"].items():
        for pid, pref in s["preferences"].items():
            traj = [v for v in pref.get("value_over_time", []) if v.get("weight") is not None]
            fw = f"{traj[-1]['weight']:.3f}" if traj else "—"
            rts = pref.get("runs_to_stick")
            display_rts = "didn't stick" if rts is None else rts
            rows.append(f"| {s.get('skill', '—')} | {scn} | {pid} | {pref['polarity']} |"
                        f" {display_rts} | {fw} |")
    display(Markdown("\n".join(rows)))
```

## Labeled KPIs (calibration harness)

The three §11 *labeled* KPIs — `capture_rate`, `regressions_prevented`, `retrieval_precision` — the
product `metrics` tool returns **`null` by design** (ordinary runtime usage has no ground truth).
The internal calibration harness (`python -m harness.calibrate`) scores them against a small
**hand-labeled set** ([`harness/calibration/labels.yaml`](https://github.com/HrudithL/whetstone/blob/main/harness/calibration/labels.yaml))
and writes `out/calibration.json`, which this page reads. The runtime tool still returns null — only
this published showcase, linked to the labeled set, shows the numbers.

```{python}
# | echo: false
# | output: asis
if m is None:
    display(not_generated_note("The labeled calibration KPIs"))
else:
    k = m["showcase_only_kpis"]
    src = k.get("calibration_source")
    rows = ["| KPI | value |", "| --- | --- |"]
    for key in ("capture_rate", "regressions_prevented", "retrieval_precision"):
        entry = k[key]
        val = entry.get("value")
        rows.append(f"| {key} | {'—  <small>(not yet calibrated)</small>' if val is None else val} |")
    display(Markdown("\n".join(rows)))
    if src:
        display(Markdown(
            f"\n<small>Computed on the `{src['backend']}` backend at {src['generated_at']} "
            f"from `{src['labels']}`.</small>"
        ))
    else:
        display(Markdown(
            "\n<small>Run `python -m harness.calibrate` (needs the `[showcase,embeddings]` extra) "
            "to populate these from the labeled set.</small>"
        ))
```
